name: Hisui Hatia
original_name: ヒスイ ハーティア
source: The hero chosen by the goddess. Though she is very weak, she is protected by the goddess and as a result, cannot die no matter how hard Jade tries to kill her.
translation: The hero chosen by the goddess. Though she is very weak, she is protected by the goddess and as a result, cannot die no matter how hard Jade tries to kill her.
